reels.title: He reduced his business by 70% in order to be with his family
reels.hook: He cut 70% of his income. Here is why.
reels.why: A strong hook in the first sentence and a concrete, brave decision with a clear number. A rounded arc: the wife's warning, the birth of the daughter, the decision.

reels.quote: All the money in this world is not enough for us if we are not okay.

reels.title: You achieve a goal, and peace lasts only two days

reels.quote: When one of those goals was reached... for two days there was peace and then, okay, what is the next goal.

reels.title: A successful man is an uncle, a successful father is my old man
reels.hook: Successful in business or successful as a dad?
reels.why: A warm, concrete picture from childhood with two contrasting role models. It ends with a sentence that summarizes everything.
reels.speaker: Fran
reels.quote: a successful man in that sort of business world was always the image of my uncle, and a successful father was always my old man to me.

reels.title: Providing for a family does not only mean financing a family
reels.hook: You pay bills. Have you really provided for the family?
reels.why: A clear insight that breaks down a common male misconception that earning is the only duty. It makes sense to share and comment on it.
reels.speaker: Mislav (Tata Hrast)
reels.quote: your task of providing for the family is not financing the family, that is only one of the points
